profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | C#/.NET • Python • Cloud & Distributed Systems
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 13+ years of experience building scalable cloud-based systems, backend architectures, and production grade distributed platforms across banking, technology, and financial services. Strong expertise in C#, .NET, Python, SQL, React, Angular, Azure, and AWS, with a track record of designing high-volume APIs, microservices, data-intensive applications, and event-driven workflows. Product focused engineer who owns solutions from architecture and technical design through development, deployment, and production operations. Experienced with distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Kafka, RabbitMQ, and Azure Service Bus, along with AI-enabled applications using Azure OpenAI and Python. Combines hands-on engineering with architecture reviews, performance optimization, production troubleshooting, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver reliable products that scale with business and customer needs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Design, test and deploy large volume banking applications using C#, .NET 8, ASP.NET Core and Blazor, building reusable application components and backend services that process over 1M daily transactions while maintaining 99.9% application uptime.
•	Modernized legacy applications into scalable service oriented solutions, integrating Angular 18 and React front ends with RESTful APIs and applying asynchronous programming, dependency injection, SOLID principles, and clean architecture to improve maintainability and extensibility.
•	Designed data-access solutions using SQL Server and T-SQL, creating database schemas, stored procedures, complex queries, indexes, and optimized execution plans that reduced average query execution time by 40%.
•	Developed Python services and automation workflows for data processing, validation, reconciliation, and application integrations, and contributed to AI enabled solutions using Azure OpenAI for LLM-powered internal capabilities and intelligent workflow automation.
•	Designed and supported cloud native applications across Microsoft Azure and AWS, using Azure App Service and AWS ECS for application hosting, Azure Functions and AWS Lambda for event driven processing, and cloud native monitoring and security services to improve scalability, observability, and production reliability.
•	Owned features throughout the complete SDLC, from requirements and technical design through development, unit/integration testing, deployment, and production support; analyzed logs and telemetry, performed root cause analysis, and implemented fixes to prevent recurring incidents.
•	Provided technical leadership through architecture reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and Agile/Scrum delivery, promoting secure coding, authentication and authorization controls, testing standards, application security, and maintainable engineering practices across development teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Engineered a web-based automation and validation platform using C#, .NET Core, and Blazor WebAssembly, enabling 200+ engineers to configure, execute, and monitor 10K+ automated validation workflows per month through a centralized self-service interface.
•	Built Python automation frameworks to orchestrate 5K+ automated test executions per week, collect and process validation telemetry, and streamline repetitive engineering workflows, reducing manual validation effort by 40% and accelerating test-result analysis.
•	Developed responsive engineering dashboards with React, Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, providing real-time visibility into test execution, failure trends, performance measurements, and validation results while creating reusable UI components for internal engineering teams.
•	Implemented backend APIs and data services with ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, and SQL Server, optimizing data models, LINQ queries, indexing strategies, and asynchronous data access for high-volume test and telemetry datasets.
•	Designed Azure-hosted application components using Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Application Insights, and Azure Monitor, implementing centralized telemetry, structured logging, alerting, and diagnostics to strengthen application reliability and production troubleshooting.
•	Built GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines to automate builds, unit and integration tests, security scanning, quality gates, release approvals, and application deployments, improving delivery consistency and software quality.
•	Led peer code and architecture reviews, mentored engineers on .NET and Python development practices, and collaborated with software, hardware, and validation teams to solve complex automation challenges; created technical documentation and training materials to support internal platform adoption.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed high-performance financial applications using C#, .NET Framework, and ASP.NET MVC, building reusable business and service-layer components for market data, portfolio analytics, and financial reporting workflows used across internal applications.
• Built interactive financial dashboards using React, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Bootstrap, creating reusable UI
components for market-data visualization, portfolio views, filtering, and analytical workflows while integrating frontend applications with RESTful services.
• Designed and implemented RESTful APIs and service-oriented components with ASP.NET Web API, providing standardized access to pricing, reference, and analytical data while supporting integration between web applications and downstream financial systems.
• Engineered data-access layers using Entity Framework, LINQ, SQL Server, and T-SQL, optimizing complex queries, stored procedures, indexes, and data models to improve retrieval performance across large financial datasets.
• Developed Python utilities and data-processing workflows to automate ingestion, validation, transformation, and
reconciliation of financial datasets, reducing repetitive operational processing and improving data quality for downstream analytics.
• Improved application responsiveness and processing efficiency through async/await, multithreading, caching, profiling, and query optimization, reducing latency by 25% across data-intensive application workflows.
• Implemented asynchronous processing and application integration using RabbitMQ and message-driven patterns,
improving reliability of financial-data workflows through retry handling, exception management, and resilient background processing.
• Developed automated unit and integration tests, participated in peer code reviews, and diagnosed production issues using application logs and debugging tools while collaborating with QA, product, and engineering teams throughout Agile/Scrum delivery cycles.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed enterprise healthcare applications using C#, .NET Framework, ASP.NET MVC, and ASP.NET Web API,
implementing patient scheduling, clinical workflows, and operational functionality with reusable business and service-layer components.
• Built responsive web interfaces using AngularJS, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and jQuery, creating reusable
components for clinical dashboards, administrative forms, and scheduling workflows while integrating frontend
functionality with RESTful APIs.
• Engineered data-access and integration solutions using Entity Framework, LINQ, and MySQL, designing relational schemas, stored procedures, complex queries, and indexing strategies to improve data retrieval and support transaction-intensive healthcare workflows.
• Developed Python automation utilities and RabbitMQ-based asynchronous workflows for data validation, scheduled processing, and application integrations; contributed to unit/integration testing, code reviews, production troubleshooting, and Agile/Scrum delivery with cross-functional engineering teams.
positions.insights: ASP.NET Web API, ASP.NET MVC and +3 skills
